vulnerabilities.name: Information disclosure in HTTP headers
vulnerabilities.description: The server discloses version information in its response headers.
vulnerabilities.solution:
* Remove headers that disclose information.
* Remove any unnecessary comments.

vulnerabilities.title: Reflected cross-site scripting
vulnerabilities.details: A request parameter is reflected into the response without encoding.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Encode user input before rendering it.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing security headers
vulnerabilities.summary: Several recommended response headers were absent.

vulnerabilities.impact: The host still negotiates a deprecated protocol version.
